_comment: Two Worlds CAST REGISTRY — the voice-identity library (per the Arabic TTS Arena thesis). Each character maps to an engine + voice identity + dialect + default performance. Adding a character = adding an entry. The synth pipeline reads this to route every script line to the right voice. Arabic voices run through the shared pronunciation brain (egyptian_lexicon.json). English voices use Chatterbox. Confirm/expand after the owner locks the final cast audition.

voicetut.note: VoiceTut built-in voices + shared Egyptian lexicon; num_step=64, guidance=2.5

chatterbox.note: Chatterbox multilingual; expressive English; exaggeration/cfg per character

arabic_voice_pool._comment: ALL 17 VoiceTut voices are now usable — the shared lexicon fixed the pronunciation that made some stumble (owner confirmed متنساش fixed across voices). Full pool available for creative casting.

arabic_recurring_cast._comment: Creative role-casting from the pool (director's picks; adjustable). Each recurring Arabic character = a locked voice identity so they sound consistent every episode.

casting_notes._comment: Creative casting guidance for assigning pool voices to characters as the story grows.
casting_notes.warm_elder: a lower, slower male (e.g. Essam) for a landlord/wise-uncle character
casting_notes.energetic_youth: brighter voices (e.g. Omar) for young/excited characters
casting_notes.kids_gulf_levantine: not in VoiceTut's set — sourced/added later as new voice identities
